newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: Zambia hosts Burundi sanctions meeting.
newsitem.headline: Zambia hosts Burundi sanctions meeting.

text.p: A one-day meeting of the regional sanctions co-ordinating committee on Burundi opened in the Zambian capital on Thursday.

A Zambian foreign affairs official said the meeting, which would be attended by representatives from Kenya, Rwanda, Tanzania, Uganda, Zaire and Zambia, would review conditions for the lifting of sanctions against Burundi implemented after a military takeover of government last year.
"The meeting, which will be chaired by the Tanzanian High Commissioner to Kenya, is expected to review conditions for the lifting of sanctions against Burundi," the official told Reuters.
Burundi's military ruler, Major Pierre Buyoya, seized power from the civilian government on July 25.

The regional sanctions commmittee set three conditions for the lifting of sanctions against Burundi: the unbanning of political parties, the restoration of parliament and the return to constitutional rule.
Thursday's meeting is the fourth to be held by the committee since it was formed last August. The first and third meetings were held in Arusha, Tanzania, and the second, in Kigali, Rwanda last year.
